fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles to an enemy and strike it twice; each strike deals 12 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Trampled Snare
fusions.desc: Stamps through the strands around you, which deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Long-Legged Outrider
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 15 seconds. A spider escort fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Saddled Weaver
fusions.desc: A bonded heidel fights beside you, striking enemies within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.6 seconds and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. You can ride it.
